secondary_task: new_three4/ordinary_12way (same photos as four-way; never pooled twice)
hypothesis: Photographs from different objects span different visually predictable EEG variation. A candidate-specific covariance may improve an individual's fixed measured-center classifier.
model: Fit the frozen posterior Fisher96 on generic objects only. Whiten the within-object centered generic projected EEG covariance with 0.9*cov+0.1*mean_eigenvalue*I. Fit generic within-object standardized unit H14 residuals to whitened EEG residuals by ridge, penalty 1.0 per sample. Scale mapped visual residuals by one generic-training scalar to mean squared length 96. For each candidate use the eight current fold support images only, subtract their mapped mean. Set Sigma=I+0.10*(mapped residuals).T@(mapped residuals)/7, rank at most seven above I. Center of each candidate is its observed eight-EEG centroid. Score increment is its Gaussian log density minus its isotropic log density at this same measured centroid, including the log determinant. Add 0.20 times the increment standardized within the registered query menu to the original standardized Fisher cosine. No parameters selected on outcomes.
sham: Keep the eight true EEG supports per candidate and common regularization. Cyclically rotate the whole set of eight support-image residuals between candidate classes in menu order by one position; every candidate receives another object's covariance from within the same menu. Same support count, folds, covariance spectra and query EEG. No candidate means are taken from pictures.
access: No query image, image-based query feature, true query class or session pair is passed into classification. Only admissible support image rows from the active menu/fold. Query-to-menu uses separately frozen ordinal registration. Score truth after locking decisions.
generic_diagnostic: Use the historical 384/128 split and original 260601 generic episode seed, 3 deterministic balanced rounds, 12-class menus, two held out/eight supports in five folds; 90 decisions per generic test class, 11,520 per person. Same hyperparameters as both target panels; generic performance will not change them.
scope: Development on two studied panels, fixed three separately fit participants. No cohort fusion or cross-person teaching. Primary pooled summary sums two distinct 120-photo panels, pairing subjects on the same whole objects. Each panel has 12 objects. Class bootstrap stratified by panel, 10,000 repetitions seed 261126. Also show per-subject and both sham comparisons. A positive outcome alone does not establish generalization to new participants.
previous: Visual prototype experiment adjusted candidate EEG centers. Global support covariance experiment used a single pooled EEG covariance for all candidates. This experiment changes each candidate's covariance from support photographs and holds all measured EEG means fixed.
advance_rule: Candidate is considered for independent replication only if joint primary candidate-minus-native AND candidate-minus-shuffled 95% lower endpoints exceed zero and at least two of three individuals improve versus native across their primary panels.
